640:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Given the circumstances, I'll save my congratulations for our ace pilots until another opportunity.」

640:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But we mustn't forget this one thing: let's get down to business, business...」

640:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe those words will save the world...」

641:t_000:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's our trump card against $$バアル$$... the culmination of humanity's wisdom...」

641:t_000:1.en:
$n
「So that's the new Buster Machine No. 3.」

641:t_001:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's huge! At that size, it's an asteroid!」

641:t_001:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It was developed using the one built in our world as a model, but the original was much, much larger.」

641:t_001:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It contained a compressed $$木星$$, and activating it created an enormous black hole.」

641:t_001:4.en:
$$厚井$$
「I can't even imagine that scale.」

641:t_001:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「But that one doesn't make a black hole, right? Can it really wipe out the $$宇宙怪獣$$ all at once, like in your world, Auntie $$カズミ$$?」

641:t_001:6.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$! Calling her that is rude!」

641:t_001:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It's fine, $$恵子$$. Given my real age, being called an auntie isn't strange at all.」

641:t_001:8.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It's hard to picture that when you look like that, though.」

641:t_001:9.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I can guarantee its destructive power.」

641:t_001:10.en:
$$桂$$
「The original creates a black hole, but the new Buster Machine No. 3 uses a $$時空震動$$ to crush the target space in the gap between dimensions...」

641:t_001:11.en:
$$桂$$
「In other words, it's an enormous $$時空震動弾$$.」

641:t_001:12.en:
$$シン$$
「Is that safe? I don't want using it to cause another $$大時空震動$$.」

641:t_001:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no need to worry about that.」

641:t_001:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$ and scientists around the world pooled the best of their technology to continue and complete $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s research.」

641:t_001:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I hear Dr. $$敷島$$, Dr. $$弓$$, and Dr. $$百目鬼$$ took part, too.」

641:t_001:16.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Uncle $$梅本$$ helped out, too, I hear.」

641:t_001:17.en:
$$スザク$$
「Apparently $$ロイド$$, $$セシル$$, and Dr. $$ラクシャータ$$ were on the staff, too.」

641:t_001:18.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Our own $$ロージェノム$$ and $$リーロン$$ helped, and so did $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s $$ＷＩＬＬ$$.」

641:t_001:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, $$ＤＥＭ$$ provided technology, too! ...Though I participated in a personal capacity...」

641:t_001:20.en:
$n
(So in the end, there's still been no word from $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$, the company that developed $$ジェニオン$$...)

641:t_001:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「It was the same with repairing spacetime during the $$時獄戦役$$. The scientists are working hard, too.」

641:t_001:22.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's thanks to people like them that we can fight humanity's enemies.」

641:t_001:23.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And there are also those who build peace and lead people after the fighting ends.」

641:t_001:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let's leave what comes afterward to them and focus only on defeating those who stand in humanity's way.」

641:t_001:25.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The Galactic Raid Fleet... This truly is an all-out battle bringing together all of humanity's strength.」

641:t_001:26.en:
$$刹那$$
「Humanity isn't alone in pooling its power.」

641:t_001:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Without the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' help, we couldn't investigate the galactic center or make this extremely long-range teleportation.」

641:t_001:28.en:
$$シモン$$
「If we bring all those different powers together, we can overcome any threat.」

641:t_001:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ and $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ are coming, too, so we've got supplies and backup covered.」

641:t_001:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We will make this operation succeed.」

641:t_001:31.en:
$$カティ$$
「$c... You are the heart of this fleet. After departure, every decision will be entrusted to you.」

641:t_001:32.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood, Brigadier General $$マネキン$$.」

641:t_001:33.en:
$$カティ$$
「Leave Earth's defense to us while you're away.」

641:t_001:34.en:
$$甲児$$
「Some of our old friends from $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ will stay on Earth.」

641:t_001:35.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let's entrust what follows to them.」

641:t_001:36.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If the worst happens, we have that, too...)

641:t_001:37.en:
$$トライア$$
(Though using it really would be a last resort...)

641:t_001:38.en:
$$カティ$$
「It's almost time to leave... Then the fleet seeing you off will withdraw.」

641:t_001:39.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Thank you, $$カティ$$. I'm glad you came.」

641:t_001:40.en:
$$カティ$$
「You'll be looking after my $$パトリック$$, after all. But he should make a good lucky charm for the voyage.」

641:t_001:41.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Let's hope his knack for surviving rubs off on us.」

641:t_001:42.en:
$$カティ$$
「I'm counting on you to safeguard humanity's future, $$クジョウ$$... No, $$スメラギ・李・ノリエガ$$.」

641:t_001:43.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I swear this mission will succeed. For everyone's sake.」

641:t_001:44.en:
$$カティ$$
「Everyone, salute the Galactic Raid Fleet! We entrust our hopes and wishes to them!」

641:t_002:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
(I'm heading out, $$カティ$$.)

641:t_002:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Miss $$ソシエ$$, Miss $$キエル$$, Queen $$ディアナ$$, Captain $$ハリー$$... We will see this through.)

641:t_002:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
(I'm counting on you to look after Earth while we're gone, $$ジャミル$$ and everyone on the $$フリーデン$$.)

641:t_002:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(Mom, $$サチ子$$, $$しげる$$, $$かおる$$, Miss $$美重子$$, Mr. $$大門$$, everyone at school...)

641:t_002:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
($$マッキー$$, Dr. $$敷島$$, Director $$大塚$$...)

641:t_002:6.en:
$$勝平$$
(Dad, Mom, Big Bro $$イチ$$, Grandpa, Grandma, $$香月$$, $$アキ$$, $$ミチ$$...)

641:t_003:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Dimensional boundary distortion confirmed! Something's coming by spatial teleportation!」

641:t_003:1.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「At a time like this!?」

641:t_003:2.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「So they won't let us venture into the galaxy after all.」

641:t_004:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「The Empire doesn't exist anymore! They're just $$サイデリアル$$ now!」

641:t_004:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All ships outside $c, fall back to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ and $$フロンティア船団$$, and continue the departure countdown!」

641:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hurry and launch! They're trying to stop us from departing!」

641:t_006:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems the pilots are like those spirits $$尸空#pilot$$ used.」

641:t_006:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll be fighting these things out in the galaxy! Let's make this a warm-up!」

641:t_006:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There are less than five minutes until departure. Please destroy the enemy force within four minutes.」
